Do you mean GB? If you can afford it, you should go with a SSD since a fusion drive is basically a SSHD. If you have been previously using a 7200 RPM drive, you won't notice a difference with the fusion drive.

As for the RAM, 8 GB is sufficient. You only need 16 GB if you plan to run multiple VMs or do heavy rendering.

Don't put a lot of faith in CPU core speed. An i7 at 1.6ghz will kill an older C2D or i3 with a faster clock speed.

Get as much RAM as you can.. trade down CPU speed for RAM if required.
